purpose: Teach: 明け方/何せ/とっさ/一々/断じて/どっぷり/浸っ/ふしぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは明け方に絵を描くのが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know, Mei loves drawing in the early morning hours.
lines.style: Soft, slightly distant recollection. Gentle smile in the voice. Slow, unhurried pace. Like she's sharing a small secret about herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、何せ初めての発表だからどきどきしてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm nervous because it's my first time showing my work.
lines.style: Breathless with anticipation. Quick, eager cadence. Bright eyes in the voice. A small tremor of vulnerability underneath the excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがとっさに翔くんを守ってあげるのよ
lines.en: Sho, Mei will protect you right away if anything happens.
lines.style: Warm, immediate reassurance. Lean into the protective word. Soft and certain, no room for doubt. Like tucking him under her arm with her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きの色を一々確認したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I checked every single color in my drawing.
lines.style: Proud, deliberate articulation. Small lift on 'every single.' Showing off just a little. Warm pride in his own careful work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは断じて翔くんを忘れたりしないわよ
lines.en: Sho, Mei would never, ever forget about you.
lines.style: Firm and absolute. Gentle strength on 'never.' No hesitation in the delivery. Tender but unshakeable — this is a promise she's making.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きにどっぷりはまってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got really into drawing and couldn't stop.
lines.style: Wide-eyed with enthusiasm. Slightly faster pace. The admission of being completely absorbed, happy about it. Boyish delight in losing himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが温泉に浸ってらしたお話、聞いた?
lines.en: Sho, did you hear about the time Dad was soaking in the hot spring?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the opening. Slightly slower pace, inviting him to settle in. Like the beginning of a story she's about to share.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、雲の形がふしぎでお絵描きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew the clouds because their shapes were so strange and wonderful.
lines.style: Earnest wonder. Soft emphasis on 'strange and wonderful.' Like he's still seeing those shapes in his mind. Small, genuine delight in the discovery.
